name: Bresenham Voxel Traversal
definition: A voxel traversal algorithm using an integral Bresenham-like error accumulation method to step through voxels along the dominant axis of the ray.
summary: Bresenham Voxel Traversal is a discrete algorithm that generates a full sequence of visited voxel coordinates using integer-like error accumulation along a ray's dominant axis, differing from floating-point DDA variants.
